u0: Base/final state: no client order has been taken, the siren is silent, and there is no food-slip recovery pending. Your hands may be empty or already holding raw food. Watch for a client or a new ring: if a client is waiting, take its order; if the siren starts, go to the switch and turn it off. Do not try to prepare food until an order has been taken.
u1: No order has been taken, the siren is ringing, and there is no food-slip recovery pending. Your hands may be empty or holding raw food. Turn the siren off at the switch; if a client is waiting, take its order as well. Do not leave the ring on while continuing other work.
u10: An order is open, the siren is off, and a slip has left the prepared meal on the floor with your hands empty. Pick up the prepared meal on the very next step, then go to the waiting client and serve. Do not return to the pantry or stove; the meal only needs recovering and delivering.
u11: An order is open, the siren is ringing, and a slip has left the prepared meal on the floor with your hands empty. Pick up the prepared meal on the very next step, then serve the waiting client and turn the siren off, in either practical order, making sure both are completed. Do not re-fetch or re-cook.
u2: An order has been taken, the siren is off, and the food has not been prepared. If empty-handed, fetch raw food from the pantry; if already carrying raw food, go to the stove. Toggle the stove to prepare the meal, then move on to serve the waiting client.
u3: An order has been taken, the siren is ringing, and the food has not been prepared. Turn the siren off at the switch; then fetch raw food if needed and prepare it at the stove. If you already have raw food at the stove, you may prepare under the ring, but the siren still needs to be switched off.
u4: An order has been taken, a prepared meal is in hand, the siren is off, and the client is waiting. Go to the client and toggle to serve. If the siren starts before the serve, treat the ring as an added obligation but keep the prepared food ready.
u5: An order has been taken, a prepared meal is in hand, the siren is ringing, and the client is waiting. Either serve the client now, which is allowed while ringing, or switch the siren off first and then serve; in both cases make sure the order is served and the ringing is stopped.
u6: No order has been taken, the siren is off, and a slip has left a raw portion on the floor with your hands empty. This is a recovery state: pick up the dropped food on the very next step, while you are turned toward it. After recovering, take a waiting client's order and resume the normal fetch-prepare-serve work.
u7: No order has been taken, the siren is ringing, and a slip has left a raw portion on the floor with your hands empty. Pick up the dropped food on the very next step; recovery comes before switching the siren off. After the pickup, turn the siren off, take a waiting client's order, and resume preparing and serving.
u8: An order is open, the siren is off, and a slip has left the raw food on the floor before preparation. Pick up that dropped portion on the very next step. Then take it to the stove, prepare it, and serve the waiting client; do not re-fetch from the pantry first.
u9: An order is open, the siren is ringing, and a slip has left the raw food on the floor before preparation. Pick up the dropped portion on the very next step; it is the food for the open order. After the pickup, turn the siren off, prepare at the stove, and serve. Keep both the ring and the order as outstanding obligations until handled.
